memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Gershonites were counted by their clans and families. All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting, counted by their clans and families, were 2,630. This was the total of those in the Gershonite clans who served at the tent of meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the Lord's command. The Merarites were counted by their clans and families. All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the tent of meeting, counted by their clans and families, were 3,200. This was the total of those in the Merarite clans. Moses and Aaron counted them as the Lord commanded through Moses. - Num 4:38-45 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Each clan is counted in turn — the Gershonites 2,630, the Merarites 3,200 — and every count is done "as the Lord commanded through Moses." The steady repetition of that phrase is like a heartbeat running through the whole chapter: obedience, obedience, obedience.

It would be easy to read these numbers and clan names and feel they have little to say to us. But look at what they reveal about God and His people. Every clan mattered. Every group was counted. Every task was covered. No clan was left out, and no clan carried more than its share.

Together, these three clans — Kohath, Gershon, and Merari — did the whole work of moving the house of God. Alone, none of them could have done it. But each doing its part, they accomplished it together.

This is God's beautiful design for His people. We need one another. Your gifts are not enough on their own, and neither are mine. But together, as each does their part, the whole work of God moves forward.

Do not underestimate your contribution, and do not undervalue others'. The Gershonites' 2,630 and the Merarites' 3,200 all counted. Every faithful servant counts in God's great work.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you recognise your need for other believers?
- How does it encourage you that every servant counts?
- Whose different contribution can you appreciate today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your work moves forward as we each do our part together. Help me to value both my role and the roles of others. Amen.
